name: Hana no Souretsu ~A Stray Children~
source:
Stage: The Dita continent, while two-thirds of the earth are occupied with wilderness and monsters. A few small countries are standing in disarray across the continent. The countries are supervised by two major forces: The Marion Republic and The Setou Foundation.

The protagonist wakes up.
He was supposed to be dead.
He doesn't remember why.

He finds himself  in a strange, dark and lonely underground facility...

[Translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url]]
translation:
舞台：迪塔大陆，地球的三分之二都被荒野和怪物占据。非洲大陆上一些小国陷入混乱。这些国家受到两大势力的监管：马里恩共和国和濑户财团。

主角醒了。
他本来应该死了。
他不记得为什么。

他发现自己身处一个陌生、黑暗、孤独的地下设施中……

[译自[url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]官方网站[/url]]
